data.body:
AC amendment: Clarify insertion point and add DD3 coverage for distinct cleanup diff logging.

## Acceptance Criteria (supplemental)

Universal Criteria:
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | tail -5
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true

Skill/Workflow Modification Criteria (AC library category):
- [ ] Skill file is valid markdown
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md
- [ ] No broken internal references in SKILL.md (detect-cleanup-recipes.sh path exists after Task 2 completes)
  Verify: grep -oE '\$PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/sprint/detect-cleanup-recipes\.sh' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md | head -1 | grep -q detect-cleanup-recipes || echo 'Reference not found'

Insertion Point Clarification (DD1 — cleanup runs AFTER sub-agents return, BEFORE review):
- [ ] Cleanup Recipe Phase step inserted in Phase F AFTER Step 6 (Collect Agent Discoveries) and BEFORE Step 7 (Acceptance Criteria Validation) in shared-directory mode — this guarantees cleanup runs after all sub-agents' output is collected and before AC validation / code review
  Verify: python3 -c "import re; txt=open('plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md').read(); idx_cleanup=txt.find('Cleanup Recipe Phase'); idx_step6=txt.find('Step 6: Collect Agent Discoveries'); idx_step7=txt.find('Step 7: Acceptance Criteria Validation'); assert idx_step6 < idx_cleanup < idx_step7, f'Insertion order wrong: step6@{idx_step6}, cleanup@{idx_cleanup}, step7@{idx_step7}'; print('OK')"
- [ ] Cleanup phase also documented for per-worktree-review-commit.md insertion (worktree isolation mode): cleanup runs AFTER sub-agent returns, BEFORE per-worktree review (Step 2 of per-worktree-review-commit.md)
  Verify: grep -q 'cleanup.*recipe\|recipe.*cleanup' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/per-worktree-review-commit.md || grep -q 'detect-cleanup-recipes' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/per-worktree-review-commit.md || grep -q 'Cleanup Recipe Phase' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md && echo 'Shared-directory mode covered'

DD3 Coverage — Sprint log records post-cleanup state as distinct entry (epic SC3):
- [ ] SKILL.md instructs sprint to log cleanup diff as a distinct ticket comment (NOT merged with sub-agent diff), before review captures the state — so completion-verifier and reviewers see the post-cleanup diff
  Verify: grep -q 'distinct.*ticket.*comment\|cleanup.*diff.*comment\|log.*cleanup.*distinct' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md

No-op handling (DD1 consideration):
- [ ] SKILL.md instructs to skip cleanup phase and produce no log entry when detect-cleanup-recipes.sh outputs nothing (no applicable recipes)
  Verify: grep -q 'no-op\|no.*output\|skip.*cleanup\|empty.*output' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md

Conflict detection (Considerations section):
- [ ] SKILL.md documents conflict detection: if cleanup recipe reverts sub-agent staged changes, log WARNING and skip that recipe for those files
  Verify: grep -q 'WARNING\|conflict.*recipe\|recipe.*conflict\|revert.*staged' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md

Doc-router attestation required:
Gate fired: 1 (skill-scoped behavior of sprint phase F)
Target file: plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md
CLAUDE.md edited directly: no

Testing Mode: UPDATE — instruction file change; tests still-valid per behavioral-testing-standard.md Rule 5 (non-executable instruction file, criterion 3: static assets only)
